criterion_rule: For every selected design and every available order, the wrapper-path critical speed must differ from Task A by no more than 0.01 rpm; baseline status must be ok; and dynamic+H1-H6 acceptance must match Task A.
action_on_failure: Do not run the six perturbation scenarios; diagnose units, material override, modal filtering and parameter passing.
scope: 44-50 selected jointly accepted designs, zero perturbation only
